map.房间照度配置计算器 使用指南: Room Illumination Configuration Calculator User Guide
map.房间照度配置计算器，按房间类型与面积求所需照度、光通量与灯具功率，辅助家居照明设: The Room Illumination Configuration Calculator works out the required illuminance, luminous flux and lamp power from the room type and area, helping with residential lighting design.
map.客厅基础照明：选客厅推荐照度 100–300lux，面积×照度得总光通量，再按单: Living room base lighting: pick the recommended 100-300 lux for a living room, multiply the area by the illuminance to get the total luminous flux, then convert to a lamp count using the lumens per fixture.
map.书房/厨房重点照明：提高局部照度（书房 300–500、厨房操作台 500+），: Task lighting for the study and kitchen: raise the local illuminance (study 300-500, kitchen worktop 500+), zone by zone.
map.节能替换：已知目标光通量，按 LED 光效（约 80–120 lm/W）反推功率: Energy-saving substitution: given a target luminous flux, back out the power with LED efficacy (about 80-120 lm/W) and compare it with the original fixture to see the energy saving headroom.
map.：示例：客厅 20㎡，取 200lux。\n• 总光通量 ≈ 20 × 200:
Example: a 20 m² living room at 200 lux.
• Total luminous flux ≈ 20 × 200 = 4000 lm
• With 800 lm LED lamps, about 5 are needed; or one 4000 lm main light
map.照度参考值哪来？: Where do the illuminance reference values come from?
map.取自《建筑照明设计标准》GB 50034 的居住建筑推荐值，因功能而异。: Taken from the recommended values for residential buildings in GB 50034 Architectural Lighting Design Standard, which vary by function.
map.用光通量÷光效（LED 约 100 lm/W）得功率；老式荧光/白炽光效低得多。: Luminous flux ÷ luminous efficacy (about 100 lm/W for LED) gives the power; old fluorescent and incandescent lamps have much lower efficacy.
map.只算主灯够吗？: Is the main light alone enough?
map.不够，建议分区（基础+重点+氛围），本工具给总量参考，实际按布局细分。: Not enough; zoning (base + accent + ambience) is recommended. This tool gives a total for reference, and you should subdivide it according to the actual layout.
